note: Byte-exact snapshots of the DRAFT FH* contract schemas the draft CEDAR templates in ../ are generated from. These are development-repo bytes, not released contracts: nothing here is a schema authority, and no w3id URL exists or is claimed for either type. scripts/make_cedar.py reads the snapshot bytes offline and refuses to generate when a snapshot no longer matches its recorded sha256; tests/test_cedar.py recomputes both the sha256 and the git blob hash against this file. Refresh procedure (maintainer-reviewed draft edits only): re-fetch the recorded path from the recorded repository at a named commit, update commit/sha256/size/retrieved here, rerun python scripts/make_cedar.py and review the template diff.
